abstract.t: This unsubmitted working draft defines an evidence-bounded archive profile for scientific and technical claims, sources, evidence tiers, falsifiers, tests, provenance, publication state, and integrity manifests. The profile is designed to prevent archival or mechanical integrity from being misread as empirical validity, novelty, peer review, standards approval, or publication acceptance. This file is an archival RFCXML working draft and has no IETF standing unless separately submitted.
